faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Research Coordinator (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 7 December 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (till the last date of the advertisement). Relaxation: Service in other research projects Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis (Only Applicable for ICMR Project).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.60,000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Essential: M.Sc. Biotechnology, or equivalent with science background and sound knowledge of Genetics, Clinical Research, Biostatistics and use of Statistical software. Desirable: Ph.D. with publications and experience in Biotechnology, Genetics, Biostatistics and use of statistical software, Clinical Research.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Experience should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification required for the post.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No additional candidates entertained after the 10:00 AM reporting closing time.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening/Scrutiny Test (at the discretion of the Competent Authority, depending on the number of applicants). Walk-in Interview. The Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants. Walk-in interview on 07-12-2026 at 10 AM.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial appointment for one year; may be extended further for two years depending upon the performance of the candidate. Purely temporary/contractual basis, co-terminus with the project. No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur or continuation in any other project.
